title: SaMo Bridge One Year Anniversary
description: One year after its launch, the city of Santa Monica’s SaMo Bridge diversion program has exceeded initial goals, connecting hundreds of justice-involved individuals to housing, treatment and supportive services. On May 14, the city celebrated four recent graduates in a special ceremony, recognizing program participants who successfully completed their 90-day rehabilitation plan through SaMo Bridge.
transcript_text: We are celebrating our one-year anniversary of Samo Bridge, a city diversion program. It's a 24-hour, 7-day a week service center that PD has access to drop folks off that are involved in the criminal justice system. We really needed a place for folks to go that wasn't jail. Our officers know that they have an opportunity to connect somebody at all hours and any time of the week with a service provider that is going to put in the effort to connect them with temporary and even permanent housing and rehabilitation solutions. >> The collaboration between the police department, housing and human services, Exodus Recovery, and the city attorney's office has made this the program that it is. As of the first year, the Santa Monica Police Department referred 462 people. We were able to immediately connect 233 individuals to housing and treatment, and we've graduated 58 individuals in that first year. SMO Bridge allows us to have like a a safe space where that person can can feel like a person and feel like themselves again and then they're reachable. >> Many of our staff are able to connect through shared experiences which helps create real relationships and reminds participants that change and recovery are possible. I wanted to thank the program for taking the time out to help me even though it was hard to get my housing, you know, but Santa Khan Police Department went out of their way and so did this program. >> I was out on the streets when some officers had stopped by um and actually got me out of a bad situation. 9 months later, I'm about to get my own housing and I can go ahead and step forward to the next point in my life. >> That's what you guys did through this program. you kept moving forward and I applaud that and it's not an easy task, right? And I applaud the city. The partnership that we have is amazing.
